name: CakES MCS Layout
definition: A 3D visualization metaphor for Minimal Cut Sets (MCSs) in fault tree analysis, representing MCSs as cylinders ('cakes') arranged in concentric rings and levels based on their Fault Probability (FP).
summary: CakES MCS Layout is a 3D visualization metaphor for fault tree analysis that represents Minimal Cut Sets as cylindrical cakes arranged in concentric rings and levels to encode risk and composition.
